summary: This page provides step-by-step instructions for setting up and performing Stick welding on the Vulcan OmniPro 220 welder, including safety warnings, polarity settings, electrode type and diameter selection, material thickness, and auto weld settings.
text_content:
Stick Welding

WARNING
TO PREVENT SERIOUS INJURY AND DEATH:
Do not weld without Grounding Clamp.
When the operator is not holding the Electrode Holder, it must be sitting on a nonconductive, nonflammable surface.

1. Turn the Power Switch to the OFF position, then plug the Welder into a properly grounded, GFCI protected, 120VAC (20 amp rated) outlet or 240V outlet. The circuit must be equipped with delayed action-type circuit breaker or fuses.

2. Set Electrode Holder down on nonconductive, nonflammable surface away from any grounded objects.

3. Turn the Power Switch ON.

4. Press Home Button on Control Panel.

5. Turn Main Control Knob until Stick process appears on LCD display screen.

6. Press Main Control Knob to select STICK process.

Note: Press Main Control Knob to go to next screen. Press Back Button to return to the previous screen.

7. Adjust settings for the STICK process.

a. Polarity Setting:
• Plug cables in according to screen.
[Display shows: - and + terminals, No Gas Required]

b. Set Electrode type:
• Turn Main Control Knob to set electrode type.
[Display shows: Stick, Electrode, 60xx]

c. Set Electrode Diameter and Material Thickness:
• Turn Left Knob to set electrode diameter.
• Turn Right Knob to set material thickness.
[Display shows: Stick, Diameter 3/32", Thickness 16 Ga]

d. Auto Weld Settings:
• Turn Left Knob to adjust output amperage.
• Turn Right Knob to ON to energize Electrode Holder.

WARNING! TO PREVENT SERIOUS INJURY: Welder is now energized and Open Circuit Voltage is present.

[Final display shows: 60 A, 0 A, ON/OFF, 0.0 V, Process: Stick, Electrode Type: 70XX, Electrode Diameter: 3/32", Material Thickness: 16Ga, Hot Start: 6, Arc Force: 0]

Electrode Holder must rest on nonconductive, nonflammable surface when not held
Do not weld without Grounding Clamp
Stick welding requires No Gas

Default example electrode diameter shown: 3/32"
Default example material thickness shown: 16 Ga
Auto weld settings show default output amperage of 60 A
Arc Force default setting: 0
Hot Start default setting: 6
Open Circuit Voltage is present when Electrode Holder is energized (Right Knob turned to ON)
Turn Left Knob to adjust output amperage in Auto Weld Settings
Turn Right Knob to ON to energize Electrode Holder
Turn Left Knob to set electrode diameter
Turn Right Knob to set material thickness
Turn Main Control Knob to set electrode type
Press Home Button on Control Panel to begin setup
Turn Main Control Knob until Stick process appears on LCD display
Press Main Control Knob to select STICK process

Press Back Button to return to previous screen

Stick welding polarity: cables plugged in per screen diagram (negative: ground clamp, positive: electrode holder)
